name: R Lakshmanan
current_role: Founder, Chairman & Managing Director, Shanthi Feeds (Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu)
profile: Founded Shanthi Feeds in 1988 as a small poultry farm in Pappampatti, near Coimbatore; it grew into an integrated broiler business (hatcheries, poultry and cattle feed mills, processing, soya/corn cultivation) with capacity of ~47 million birds a year, and also runs wind energy projects.
interesting_fact: Shanthi Feeds has set up more than 1,000 contract broiler farms over 30 years and in 2019 commissioned a Petersime single-stage hatchery able to hatch 14+ million eggs a year; the group also invests in wind energy.
deep_cut_fact: He started the business in Pappampatti, a rain-shadow area so dry that conventional farming was limited, and expanded with the explicit aim of creating paid work in the village.
notes: Very low public profile; no interviews found. Alive status not confirmed though a 'Lakshmanan, Shanthi Hatcheries' chaired a Poultry Farmers Regulatory Committee summit in Nov 2025 (businessminutes.in). Wind-energy angle may suit the energy podcast. Best route: company website/office in Coimbatore.

name: Bian Xingcai
profile: Former actual controller of Sanfangxiang Group (Jiangyin, Jiangsu; polyester/PET, textiles, chemicals), listed vehicle Sanfangxiang 600370.SH. Died 6 March 2024; his stake passed by inheritance to his children (Bian Pinggang, Bian Huigang, Bian Pingfang).
notes: Deceased 6 March 2024 per Sanfangxiang (600370) takeover report filed Nov 2024: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202411181640939154_1.pdf . Rest skipped per instructions. Group now controlled by the next generation.

name: Vamanrai V Parekh
current_role: Chairman Emeritus, Nilkamal Ltd (stepped down from the board in Aug 2020)
profile: First-generation entrepreneur who, with brother Sharad, left the family button business in 1981 to make plastic household goods in a rented shed in Powai, Mumbai. That became Nilkamal, the listed maker of moulded plastic furniture, material-handling crates/pallets, mattresses and @Home retail. He was Chairman 1990-2020 and is now Chairman Emeritus; sons Hiten and Manish are in the business.
interesting_fact: Nilkamal describes itself as the world's largest producer of moulded plastic furniture, selling in about 30 countries; it has been listed on NSE/BSE since 1991.
deep_cut_fact: The crate business that made Nilkamal began when the brothers noticed wooden crates carrying milk bottles at Worli Dairy and realised plastic crates would be lighter, more durable and cheaper. The family firm itself traces back to a one-machine metal-button shed their father Vrajlal Parekh started in 1934.
notes: Elderly (about 88 per data providers) and retired from the board in 2020; no recent public statements found, and no death reports found. Hurun wealth shared with brother Sharad V Parekh. Best route: via Nilkamal company secretary or investor relations. The 1934 button-shed detail comes from Nilkamal's 'Our Journey' page (https://nilkamal.com/?p=201).
